# Atul Sah

> Official portfolio, published technical books, enterprise software projects, and AI articles by Atul Sah — Computer Science Educator at B.N. College and Full-Stack Software Developer.

Atul Sah is a Computer Science Educator and Full-Stack Developer with a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) from Patna University. He serves as Faculty of Computer Science at B.N. College (Department of Computer Application) and has published 8 technical books on Amazon covering Agentic AI, Java Programming, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Cybersecurity.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://atulsah.in/): Professional portfolio overview, featured enterprise projects, and technical biography.
- [About](https://atulsah.in/about): Detailed academic credentials (MCA, BCA), faculty position at B.N. College, and professional timeline.
- [Skills](https://atulsah.in/skills): Technical competencies across Web Development (React, Node.js, Express), Databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), and AI/ML (TensorFlow.js, Scikit-Learn, Gemini AI).
- [Projects](https://atulsah.in/projects): Portfolio of 10 software projects including Hyphenet Enterprise Portal, CampusPulse LMS, and machine learning models.
- [Publications](https://atulsah.in/publications): Complete catalogue of 8 self-published technical books available on Amazon India.
- [Blog](https://atulsah.in/blog): In-depth technical articles on Artificial Intelligence, Edge Computing, and Multi-Agent Systems.
- [Contact](https://atulsah.in/contact): Direct contact channels for software consulting, educational workshops, and collaborations.

## Technical Articles

- [Small Language Models (SLMs) & Edge AI](https://atulsah.in/blogs/blog-small-language-models): Why smaller 1B–8B domain-specific models running locally on edge hardware are the future of practical AI.
- [Multi-Agent Systems (MAS)](https://atulsah.in/blogs/blog-multi-agent-systems): How teams of specialised AI agents collaborating via Model Context Protocol (MCP) are replacing monolithic models.
- [AI Agents Are Becoming Autonomous](https://atulsah.in/blogs/blog-ai-agents-autonomous): Evolution from reactive chatbots to goal-driven digital workers with tools and memory.
- [How Open-Source LLMs Are Changing the AI Industry](https://atulsah.in/blogs/blog-open-source-llms): Analysis of open-weight models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen) democratizing private local deployment.

## Published Books

- [Agentic AI Systems & Autonomous Agents](https://www.amazon.in/Agentic-AI-Systems-Autonomous-Agents-ebook/dp/B0H8FP3VGX): Comprehensive guide to building autonomous AI agents, multi-agent frameworks, and RAG architectures.
- [Introduction to Java Programming](https://www.amazon.in/Introduction-Java-Programming-Practical-Concepts-ebook/dp/B0GHXRBLZD): Clear, practical guide to core Java programming for beginners and undergraduate students.
- [Generative AI: An Introduction](https://www.amazon.in/Generative-AI-Introduction-Atul-Sah-ebook/dp/B0GL26R2XR): Guide to principles, tools, and real-world workflows of generative artificial intelligence.
- [Machine Learning: From Basics to Advance](https://www.amazon.in/Machine-Learning-Advance-Atul-Sah-ebook/dp/B0GBWYHLDC): Step-by-step roadmap to mastering ML algorithms and mathematical foundations.
- [The Unseen Battlefield](https://www.amazon.in/Unseen-Battlefield-Revolutionizing-Cybersecurity-Cybercrime-ebook/dp/B0G3XG55HX): How AI is revolutionizing cybersecurity and cybercrime defense mechanisms.
- [The AI Product Manager](https://www.amazon.in/AI-Product-Manager-Prompt-Production-ebook/dp/B0FXWL4CXT): Journey of deploying robust artificial intelligence products from prompt to production.
- [The Promptcrafter's Handbook](https://www.amazon.in/Promptcrafters-Handbook-First-Advanced-Dialogue-ebook/dp/B0G5262DT1): Practical frameworks for engineering effective prompts for LLMs.
- [The AI-Powered Shield](https://www.amazon.in/AI-Powered-Shield-Guide-Modern-Cybersecurity-ebook/dp/B0FYGZ95DB): Role of Machine Learning algorithms in defense configurations and threat audits.
